summary.ko: 측정 기준을 세우고 실제 증거로 병목·개선·재측정 계획을 좁힙니다.
summary.en: Find evidence-backed bottlenecks and compare targeted improvements against a measured baseline.

exclusions: Generic code cleanup with no measured performance issue

required_inputs.description: Slow operation, representative workload, and user impact
Existing timings or access to an authorized local measurement method

workflow.instruction: Define the metric, workload, environment, and repeatable baseline before suggesting optimization.
Separate network, rendering, computation, storage, and third-party costs using available traces or measurements.
Rank a small set of changes by observed impact and implementation risk, avoiding speculative micro-optimizations.
Repeat the same measurement after an authorized change and report sample size, variability, and trade-offs.

deliverables.name: Performance diagnosis
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Links bottleneck hypotheses to measurements and missing evidence

deliverables.name: Optimization experiment
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Defines baseline, intervention, metric, workload, and success threshold

limitations: Do not claim a speedup from intuition or non-comparable runs.
Synthetic tests may not represent real client workloads.
permission_boundaries: Do not stress external systems, increase paid resource use, or disable security controls.
Use sanitized profiles and avoid recording private production payloads.
